file_manual_hint: The file dialog is not available here: paste the full path to the file.
file_picking: The file dialog is open (it may be behind the browser window)...
profile_legend: What do you want to get?
profile_tv_desc: A video with the subtitles drawn into the picture (plays on any TV) and a subtitle file.
profile_laptop_desc: Subtitle files for VLC (plain, styled, bilingual) and a video with switchable subtitles. Fast: no re-encoding.
profile_all_desc: Both of the above. Takes the longest.
web3_label: The video is about smart contracts (adds the Web3 glossary)
lang_not_measured: Translation quality into this language has not been measured; only Russian has.
est_time_rough: first run on this computer: rough estimate
est_over_limit: The estimate is above the limit of {limit} USD per video.
est_confirm: I agree to spend up to {amount} USD on this video
est_confirm_none: Start without a cost estimate (Claude still stops above {limit} USD)
est_audio_only: This is an audio file: subtitles only, no video files.
est_busy: Another video is being processed; wait until it finishes.
run_note: You can close this page; open it again to see the progress. Stopping a run is not possible yet.
purpose_tv: for the TV (subtitles in the picture)
hint_doctor: Something the tool needs is missing: see the setup check below.
hint_youtube: YouTube may have changed something. See the setup check below, or download the video yourself and use "File on this computer".
hint_outputs: The subtitles may be ready, but a file could not be written. Check that ffmpeg is installed (setup check below).
hint_cost_limit: The cost is above the limit; nothing more was spent. Estimate again and confirm the amount.
hint_input: Check the link or the file and try again.
hint_log: The details are in the log file (folder logs\web in the project).
err_neither_given: Paste a link or choose a file.
err_both_given: Give either a link or a file, not both.
err_bad_url: This is not a link to a YouTube video.
err_playlist: Playlists are not supported here yet: use the desktop launcher.
err_not_absolute: Give the full path to the file (starting with a drive letter).
err_not_a_file: This is a folder, not a file.
err_bad_extension: This is not a video or audio file.
err_unreadable_file: The file could not be read as video or audio.
err_youtube: YouTube did not answer as expected.
err_busy: Another video is being processed; wait until it finishes.
err_cost_mismatch: The estimate has changed: estimate again.
err_confirm_no_estimate: Confirm that you want to start without a cost estimate.
err_bad_token: Reload the page (the server was restarted).
err_network: The local server does not answer. Is the Talk Autopsy window still open?
err_outside_output: This folder cannot be opened from here.
err_internal: Unexpected error; the details are in the log file.
